[P2] Require a test for the classification type guard

Every classification reply in the added tests has `type: "choice"`, including the invalid-choice case. Deleting this guard therefore leaves their assertions unchanged, although a reply such as `{ answers: { answer: { type: "noul", choice: "a" } } }` would then be accepted and checkpointed for choices `["a", "b"]`. This violates CONTRIBUTING rule 4. Return to the validation/test design and require rejection of a wrong discriminator even when its choice field is valid.
